dfr1231_init.tooltip: Initialize the UNIHIKER K10 DFR1231 IO extender: I2C address 0x33, uses edge SDA/SCL, blocks until the device is ready

dfr1231_set_io_mode.tooltip: Set a C0-C3 multi-function port to digital output or digital input mode

dfr1231_gpio_write.tooltip: Set the digital output level of a C port: HIGH=1, LOW=0 (set digital output mode first)

dfr1231_gpio_read.tooltip: Read the level of a C port (set digital input mode first); returns 0 or 1, or 255 on failure
